infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID confirms it is you checking in or out, so attendance cannot be punched on your behalf.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: A photo is taken with each check-in and attached to the record, so attendance can be reviewed.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is recorded with each check-in and check-out, so the attendance record shows where it was marked from.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is used to record and send voice messages in chat.
